## How each date is worked out

The meeting date is the date in the heading `# Committee meeting, …`. Every heading includes the year 2026. Filenames that omit the year use that heading year. The "Next meeting" lines agree with the following note's heading, which is a second check.

`minutes 25 aug.md` is the one mismatch. Its heading is **26 August 2026**, and the first line says the meeting was moved from 25 August because of the storm. The file will be named for **26 August 2026**, the day the meeting was held. The note text stays as it is, including the word "Monday": 25 August 2026 was a Tuesday.

| Current file | Heading date | Weekday in 2026 |
|---|---|---|
| `aug11.md` | 11 August 2026 | Tuesday |
| `minutes 25 aug.md` | 26 August 2026 | Wednesday |
| `Meeting sept 8.md` | 8 September 2026 | Tuesday |
| `notes_2026-09-22.md` | 22 September 2026 | Tuesday |
| `oct6 meeting notes.md` | 6 October 2026 | Tuesday |
| `2026.10.20 minutes.md` | 20 October 2026 | Tuesday |
| `Nov 3 (final).md` | 3 November 2026 | Tuesday |

## Renames

All seven stay in `notes/`. Only the names change. `README.md` and `members.csv` stay untouched.

- `notes/aug11.md` → `notes/2026-08-11-committee-meeting.md`
- `notes/minutes 25 aug.md` → `notes/2026-08-26-committee-meeting.md`
- `notes/Meeting sept 8.md` → `notes/2026-09-08-committee-meeting.md`
- `notes/notes_2026-09-22.md` → `notes/2026-09-22-committee-meeting.md`
- `notes/oct6 meeting notes.md` → `notes/2026-10-06-committee-meeting.md`
- `notes/2026.10.20 minutes.md` → `notes/2026-10-20-committee-meeting.md`
- `notes/Nov 3 (final).md` → `notes/2026-11-03-committee-meeting.md`

Each rename is a same-folder `mv`. The files will not be opened for writing. This folder is not a git repository, so there is no `git mv`.

## `notes/index.md`

A new file, meetings in date order. Each entry is the note link plus one line taken from what that meeting agreed or assigned:

- **11 August 2026.** Odile Fairweather will repaint the noticeboard by 25 August, Paolo will move the shed lights to the night rate, and Nell will ask the city about a second tap by 8 September.
- **26 August 2026.** The meeting was held a day after the storm postponement; Nell will ask the city again about the second tap before 8 September.
- **8 September 2026.** The shed roof will be replaced before winter; Tessa will bring three quotes on 22 September, and Ibrahim will email autumn fee reminders by 15 September.
- **22 September 2026.** The committee chose the $1,480 roof quote because it includes removing the old roofing; Ibrahim will send fee reminders by 29 September, Nell will order four cubic metres of compost by 2 October, and Dov Marchetti will take over the second-tap request by 20 October.
- **6 October 2026.** The garden closes at the end of November; Wren will replace the gate latch by 20 October, and Tessa will draft a winter closing checklist, last year's plus the water shut-off, by 3 November.
- **20 October 2026.** The work day is Saturday 14 November, 09:30 to 12:30, members bring gloves and the club supplies soup; the roof invoice stays unpaid until Paolo finds out what the extra $80 is for.
- **3 November 2026.** No further meetings this year; checklist comments are due to Tessa by 10 November, the roof invoice stays unpaid until the extra $80 is explained, Ibrahim will send the work-day notice by 7 November, and Wren will shut off the water on 14 November.

Before renaming, each note will be copied to `/tmp` and `README.md` and `members.csv` will be hashed. After the renames:

1. `cmp` each new note against its `/tmp` copy. Any difference stops the job.
2. Recompute SHA-256 and byte size. Each new name must match the row above.
3. `notes/` must contain exactly those seven files plus `notes/index.md`.
4. `README.md` and `members.csv` must still match the hashes taken at the start.

The `/tmp` copies are deleted after the check. Stopping here.
